Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 20-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Raipur Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 20-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Raipur JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to send the application via email for the Junior Research Fellow post at NIT Raipur is 20 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow at NIT Raipur?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow post in the NIT Raipur recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NIT Raipur JRF posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Junior Research Fellow posts at NIT Raipur is via Email. Candidates need to send their applications to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Junior Research Fellow at NIT Raipur?
faq.answer: The selected Junior Research Fellow will receive a salary of Rs 37,000/- per month, along with HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Raipur is 28 years. Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications for JRF at NIT Raipur?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Post Graduate Degree in Physics/Electronics/Related Subject with CSIR-UGC NET or GATE or a national-level examination.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for NIT Raipur JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the NIT Raipur Junior Research Fellow recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Raipur will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is NIT Raipur located?
faq.answer: NIT Raipur is located in Raipur, Chhattisgarh, with the pincode 492010. It is a prominent institute in the region.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for NIT Raipur?
faq.answer: The official website for National Institute of Technology Raipur is https://www.nitrr.ac.in, where candidates can find more information and updates.
